artist.description: Easy Wanderlings embody the next wave of Indian independent music, crafting a lush blend of soul, pop, and R&B. Their acclaimed EP Caught in a Parade was named the Best Indian EP of 2022 by Rolling Stone India, while its single Mayflower earned a spot in Apple Music India’s 100 Best Songs of 2022. The collective has graced stages at leading festivals including Lollapalooza India, Bacardi NH7 Weekender, and Vh1 Supersonic, and were invited to represent India at the SXSW Music Festival in Austin. Recognized as rising voices in the global music landscape, they have been spotlighted in both Spotify RADAR and Apple’s UP-NEXT program. In a country widely celebrated for its Bollywood sound, Easy Wanderlings offer a refreshing perspective…music shaped by global influences yet deeply enriched with Indian artistry and storytelling.
